io.github.jabrena.juno.hardware.net.http.JsonValue

Packages that use JsonValue
Package
Description
io.github.jabrena.juno.hardware.net.http
HTTP support built on Wifi's connection, next to the JDK's java.net.http client that programs send requests with and the JDK's com.sun.net.httpserver that they serve requests with: Json and JsonValue to read values directly out of a response or request body without building a parsed document, JsonWriter to write JSON into a buffer, and HttpMethod/HttpStatus as named constants for both directions.
